title: Microsoft Purview: new Data Security Posture Management experience
summary: The roadmap facts, portal controls and documented behaviour are supported, including the agent deactivation path flagged by the pre-check. Minor corrections should clarify the unpublished agent consumption rate and remove two monitoring instructions that have no corresponding controls-table row.
